prompt:
Priority task: fix Early Heat Radar market-session correctness, especially Korean-user "day market" and U.S. premarket detection.

Read the real current project state, latest .runtime/automation-handoff-latest.json and .runtime/harness-state.json before editing. Perform this as one bounded session-engine/data-capability task only. Preserve the existing dirty overlay and do not reset/clean/checkout/stash/rebase unrelated work.

Requirements:
1) Treat America/New_York as the canonical exchange timezone and derive local display times from it. Do not hardcode a fixed UTC offset. Correctly handle U.S. DST and market holidays/weekday boundaries.
2) Make session semantics explicit and testable. At minimum distinguish DAYMARKET/OVERNIGHT, PREMARKET, REGULAR, AFTERHOURS, CLOSED, plus feed-unavailable/degraded state where relevant.
3) For Korean broker display/trading windows, support the currently documented windows:
   - DST: DAYMARKET 09:00-16:15 KST, PREMARKET 17:00-22:30 KST, REGULAR 22:30-05:00 KST, AFTERHOURS 05:00-08:30 KST.
   - Standard time: DAYMARKET 10:00-17:15 KST, PREMARKET 18:00-23:30 KST, REGULAR 23:30-06:00 KST, AFTERHOURS 06:00-09:30 KST.
   Keep broker-window policy configurable rather than scattering magic times through UI code.
4) Distinguish venue/session state from quote-provider capability. Blue Ocean ATS overnight trading is 20:00-04:00 ET; SIP is closed during BOATS. If the active fallback/provider cannot supply real overnight/day-market quotes, DO NOT report the market as CLOSED and DO NOT fabricate prices. Surface a clear provider-capability/degraded indicator such as DAYMARKET_ACTIVE_FEED_UNAVAILABLE.
5) Inspect current providers (including Yahoo/SEC fallback and any Toss/cloud adapters) and add a small capability model describing which sessions each source can actually cover.
6) Fix the scanner/radar filtering so premarket candidates are not accidentally dropped because regular-session fields are empty/stale. For DAYMARKET, only scan if a provider actually has valid current data; otherwise show the degraded state.
7) Keep Session Ribbon/Linked Workspace consistent with the same single session engine. Remove duplicate time-window logic if present.
8) Add deterministic tests around DST and boundaries. Include at least:
   - current September DST day
   - post-DST winter day
   - DAYMARKET->gap->PREMARKET boundaries
   - PREMARKET->REGULAR boundary
   - REGULAR crossing midnight KST
   - AFTERHOURS end
   - weekend/holiday-safe behavior
   - active session with unsupported provider must be ACTIVE_FEED_UNAVAILABLE, not CLOSED.
9) Run the smallest relevant unit tests, lint/typecheck/build checks available for touched code, and git diff --check.
10) Real/live order execution must remain disabled. Paper/Shadow only. Do not modify anything that enables actual orders.

In your result summarize root cause(s), exact files changed, test/build evidence, any provider limitations that still prevent true day-market scanning, and the next recommended bounded task (Android notifications).
